items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I went back and joined Charlotte Crispin.

ctx.x: Then you went back to the boat after you'd been here in 22. Is that right? No.

Let me see what did I do. 22. I went back and joined Charlotte Crispin. I left here and went to St. Louis. I joined Charlotte Crispin. Then in 23, I joined the quit Charlotte Crispin band and went with Dewey Jackson band on the boat back to New Orleans. 24, I came on back to St. Louis. Left St. Louis, went on back to New Orleans, joined City Days Band. Still was sitting in the Daz Bean Band until 27. Mudd Carey said for me to come back out here to join him, where he was in Chicago. See?
Yeah, that's that picture where you were playing tuba.

items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I worked on the boat with, uh, Charlotte Craig.

ctx.x: So you got to know where all those rocks are. Yeah. How long were you with Faith Merrill?

From about, 1918 afternoon till about around 19. 19, 19, 19, I didn't work with Faith No More on the boat. But I worked on the boat and I went back on the boat with, uh- I worked on the boat with Dewey Jackson. I worked on the boat with Eddie Allen. I worked on the boat with, uh, Charlotte Craig. I worked on the island Queen too, or the Cincinnati. And the captain got all sorted with us. Man, we had the people screaming. And he said, Jesus Christ, you fell in a bunch of sticks. They got us screaming over there.…
